releases.name: mark 0.16.1
releases.body:
Release v0.16.1.

Source: 3fc8865cd32d79889412be1c53f840b23395771f

Install with Homebrew:

```sh
brew install phongndo/tap/mark-cli
```

With the install script:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phongndo/mark/main/scripts/install.sh | sh
```

With mise:

```sh
mise use -g github:phongndo/mark
```

With Nix:

```sh
nix profile add github:phongndo/mark
```

Update an existing install with `mark update`, however you installed it. See [Install](https://github.com/phongndo/mark#install).

releases.name: mark nightly
releases.body:
Nightly build from CI-qualified main.

Commit: 3fc8865cd32d79889412be1c53f840b23395771f

Switch mark to nightly:

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/phongndo/mark/main/scripts/install.sh | MARK_VERSION=nightly sh
```

Switch back to stable:

```sh
mark update
```
